articles.summary: GENEVA, Ohio–(BUSINESS WIRE)–Advanced Energy's TEGAM, Inc., a leading supplier of digital hand held thermometers for 30 years, is introducing a new series of industrial thermocouple thermometers to aid food manufacturers in preventing foodborne illness.
articles.title: New TEGAM Bluetooth® Hand-Held Datalogging Thermometers Aid Food Manufacturers in Preventing Foodborne Illness
